payload.prompt:
Paint historical key art in hand-painted 2D animation style with soft oil-brush character. Use one dominant subject with a modest set of supporting groups: enough context for a lived-in scene, but no exhaustive inventory. Use only the element families selected below.

Allowed scene elements ONLY: One connected granary range and receiving gate; one grain cart; one porter group; one compact grain-sack stack; one low weighing shelter; one short row of matching delivery carts; one short unloading-platform group; one low granary-yard wall.

Composition: View three-quarter from courtyard height. The long granary roof mass leads from left toward the gate at right-center; the small cart rests at that gate. Repeated storehouse doors are a few dark rhythms. Cluster porters and sacks beside the existing cart at the receiving gate. This gives loading activity without scattering cargo through the courtyard. The shelter sits beside the receiving gate and carts recede along the same porter route. Keep the cart silhouettes grouped, without animals or new cargo types. Join platforms to the existing storehouse doors and the wall to the cart route. Keep loading activity gathered near the receiving gate rather than dispersed across the entire yard.

Use large joined color shapes, broad light-and-shadow planes and a few deliberate brush strokes. The subject takes most of the visual weight; supporting forms are smaller, softer and lower in contrast. Keep recognizable proportions, but simplify repeated structure and omit surface microdetail. No individually drawn leaves, grass blades, bricks, cracks, wood grain, faces or costume ornament. Use warm ochre and terracotta against cool slate-blue shadows, with restrained accents.

Paint one continuous full-bleed scene across the entire requested canvas, edge to edge and corner to corner. Continue the painted setting naturally to every edge, including the top and bottom. No white or black bars, unpainted margins, letterboxing, borders, matting or inset picture. Keep the complete principal subject comfortably inside the canvas without creating an inner frame. Surrounding space remains painted atmosphere and ground with the same visual style; do not fill it with additional object categories or a vast empty foreground.

Keep to the listed element families. Each support stays a compact group; do not expand it into many new object types, occupations, material varieties, animal species or scenery. Small same-type repetition is allowed within a group. Keep secondary forms quiet and the main subject unmistakable. No busy panorama, photographic detail, 3D rendering, collage, readable text, logo, watermark or UI.
